notes.title: Early Access release date is August 29th
notes.notes:
🚀 Hey Iridio fans! Quick update on our Early Access launch! 💫

We’ve got some news: our Early Access release on Steam is going to be postponed just a little bit. Why? Because Iridio is still a work in progress, and we want to give you the best possible experience when it finally lands in your hands. 🎮✨

New EA release date is:  August 29th 2025

We're currently deep in refining, tweaking, fixing, testing. 
This extra summer time will help us make Iridio smoother, more fun, and more worthy of the awesome community that’s been cheering us on. 🙌

Thanks so much for your patience and your support! It really keeps us going. 💚🤍

Stay tuned for more updates coming!

KR Games team

notes.title: Iridio will release in Q2 2025!
notes.notes:
Hello, Iridio fans!

We have a quick update to share on the release timeline for Iridio. 

To ensure a smooth and polished experience, we’re moving the Early Access launch for Iridio, which will now take place in Q2 2025, with the full game targeted for an April/May release.

We appreciate your ongoing support and patience as we work to make Iridio the best experience possible. 

Thank you for being on this journey with us! 💚🤍

KR Games Team
